question: Who Owns Wingstop?
quick_answer: Wingstop is an independent, publicly traded company listed on the NASDAQ under the ticker WING, so it is owned by its shareholders rather than a parent company. It was founded in 1994 in Garland, Texas, and went public in 2015. Almost all Wingstop locations are run by franchisees.
key_facts: Publicly traded on the NASDAQ under ticker WING

body.heading: Who owns Wingstop?
body.text: Wingstop is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders. It trades on the NASDAQ stock exchange under the ticker WING and is run by its own management and board, not owned by a larger restaurant group.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Wingstop was founded in 1994 in Garland, Texas, built around cooked-to-order wings in a range of flavors. It grew steadily and held its initial public offering in 2015, becoming a publicly traded company.

body.heading: A franchise model
body.text: The vast majority of Wingstop restaurants are run by independent franchisees rather than owned directly by the company. Wingstop as a corporation focuses on the brand, menu and supply, while local owners handle day-to-day operations.

faqs.a: Yes. Wingstop trades on the NASDAQ under the ticker WING, so it is owned by its shareholders.
Wingstop was founded in 1994 in Garland, Texas.
Wingstop held its initial public offering in 2015.
